Unhon ne farmaya main wahan nahi jaunga is liye ke maine unhein mashwara diya ke aapas mein larne wali jamaaton yaani Hazrat Ali aur un ke muqabilin ke bare mein aap dakhal na deejiye lekin unhon ne na mana aur dakhal diya. Maine unhein qasam di aur kaha ke nahi aap mujhe zaroor wahan le chaliye. Khair ba-mushkil tamam woh raazi hue aur main un ke sath gaya. Ummul Momineen sahiba ne Hazrat Hakim ki aawaz pehchan li aur kaha kya Hakim hai? Jawab diya gaya ke haan huzoor main Hakim bin Aflah hoon. Poocha tumhare sath kaun hain? Kaha Saeed bin Hisham. Poocha Hisham kaun? Amir ke larke? Kaha haan Amir ke larke, to Hazrat Aisha ne Hazrat Amir ke liye dua-e-rahmat ki aur farmaya Amir bahut achha aadmi tha Allah us par raham kare. Maine kaha Ummul Momineen mujhe bataiye Rasulullah ﷺ ke akhlaq kya the? Aap ne farmaya kya tum Quran nahi parhte? Maine kaha kyun nahi? Farmaya bas Huzoor ﷺ ka khuluq Quran tha. Ab main ne ijazat mangne ka qasd kiya lekin foran hi yaad aa gaya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ki raat ki namaz ka haal bhi daryaft kar loon, is sawal ke jawab mein Ummul Momineen ne farmaya kya tum ne Surah Muzzammil nahi parhi?

Main ne kaha haan parhi hai, farmaya suno is surat ke awal hisse mein qiyam-ul-lail farz hua aur saal bhar tak Huzoor ﷺ aur aap ke ashab tahajjud ki namaz ba-taur farziyat ke ada karte rahe yahan tak ke qadmon par warm aa gaya, barah mah ke baad is surat ke khatimah ki ayatein utrin aur Allah Ta'ala ne takhfif kar di, farziyat uth gayi aur amli surat baqi reh gayi, main ne phir uthne ka irada kiya lekin khayal aaya ke witr ka masla bhi دریافت (daryaft) karloon to main ne kaha Ummu-l-Mu'minin Huzoor ﷺ ke witr parhne ki kaifiyat se bhi aagah farmayiye, aap ne farmaya haan suno hum aap ki miswak wazu ka pani waghera tayyar ek taraf rakh diya karte the jab bhi Allah chahta aur aap ki aankh khulti uthte miswak karte wazu karte aur aath rakat parhte beech mein tashahhud mein bilkul na baithte aathwin rakat poori kar ke aap attahiyat mein baithte Allah tabaraka wa ta'ala ka zikr karte dua karte aur zor se salam pherte ke hum bhi sun len phir baithte baithte hi do rakat aur ada karte (aur ek witr parhte) beta yeh sab mil kar gyarah rakat huin, ab jabke aap umr-rasidah hue aur badan bhari ho gaya to aap ne saat witr parhe phir salam pherne ke baad baith kar do rakat ada kin bas beta yeh nau rakat huin aur Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jab kisi namaz ko parhte to phir us par mudawamat karte haan agar kisi shughl ya neend ya dukh takleef aur bimari ki wajah se raat ko namaz na parh sakte to din ko barah rakat ada farma liya karte, main nahi jaanti ke kisi ek raat mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne poora Quran subah tak parha ho aur na Ramadan ke siwa kisi aur mahine ke poore roze rakhe, ab main Ummu-l-Mu'minin se rukhsat ho kar Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur wahan ke tamam sawal jawab doharaye aap ne sab ki tasdeeq ki aur farmaya agar meri bhi aamad-o-raft Ummu-l-Mu'minin ke paas hoti to ja kar khud apne kaanon sun aata, yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai, Ibn Jarir mein hai Hazrat Aisha R.A farmati hain main Nabi ﷺ ke liye boriya rakh diya karti jis par aap tahajjud ki namaz parhte logon ne kahin yeh khabar sun li aur raat ki namaz mein Huzoor ﷺ ki iqtida karne ke liye woh bhi aa gaye Huzoor ﷺ ghasabnak ho kar bahir nikle chunke shafqat-o-rahmat aap ko ummat par thi aur sath hi dar tha ke aisa na ho yeh namaz farz ho jaye aap un se farmane lage ke logo in hi aamal ki takleef uthao jin ki tum mein taqat ho Allah Ta'ala sawab dene se na thakega albatta tum amal karne se thak jaoge sab se behtar amal woh hai jis par dawam ho sake idhar Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh ayatein utrin aur sahaba ne qiyam-ul-lail shuru kiya yahan tak ke rasiyan bandhne lage ke neend na aa jaye aath mahine isi tarah guzar gaye un ki is koshish ko jo woh Allah ki raza-mandi ki talab mein kar rahe the dekh kar Allah ne bhi un par raham kiya aur ise farz isha ki taraf lota diya aur qiyam-ul-lail chhod diya, yeh riwayat Ibn Abi Hatim mein bhi hai lekin is ka rawi Musa bin Ubaidah Zubaidi zaeef hai asl hadith baghair Surah Muzzammil ke nazil hone ke zikr ke sahih mein bhi hai aur is hadith ke alfaaz ke tasalsul se to yeh paya jata hai ke yeh surat Madinah mein nazil hui halanki darasal yeh surat Makkah Sharif mein utri hai, isi tarah is riwayat mein hai ke aath mahine ke baad is ki aakhri ayatein nazil huin yeh qaul bhi ghareeb hai, sahih wahi hai jo bi-hawala Musnad pehle guzar chuka ke saal bhar ke baad aakhri ayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi Ibn Abi Hatim mein manqul hai ke Surah Muzzammil ki ibtidai aayton ke utarne ke baad Sahaba-e-Kiram misl Ramzan Sharif ke qiyam ke qiyam karte rahe aur is Surah ki awal aakhir ki aayton ke utarne mein taqreeban saal bhar ka fasla tha. Hazrat Abu Usama se bhi Ibn Jarir mein isi tarah marwi hai, Hazrat Abu Abdul Rahman farmate hain ke ibtidai aayton ke utarne ke baad Sahaba-e-Kiram ne saal bhar tak qiyam kiya yahan tak ke unke qadam aur pindliyon par warm aa gaya phir aayat (Faqra'u ma tayassara minhu - 73. (Al-Muzzammil: 20) nazil hui aur logon ne rahat paayi, Hasan Basri aur Suddi ka bhi yahi qaul hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein ba-riwayat Hazrat Ayesha solah mahine ka fasla marwi hai, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ek saal ya do saal tak qiyam karte rahe pindliyan aur qadam sooj gaye phir aakhri Surah ki aayten utrin aur takhfeef ho gayi. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) das saal ka fasla batate hain (Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke pehli aayat ke hukm ke mutabiq imandaron ne Qiyam-ul-Lail shuru kiya lekin badi mashaqqat padti thi phir Allah Ta'ala ne rahem kiya aur aayat (Alima an sayakunu minkum marda - 73. (Al-Muzzammil: 20) se (Ma tayassara minhu) tak aayten nazil farma kar wus'at kar di aur tangi na rakhi fa-lillahil hamd. Phir farman hai apne Rab ke naam ka zikr karta rah aur karta rah aur uski ibadat ke liye farigh ho ja, yaani umoor-e-duniya se farigh ho kar dil-jam'i aur itminan ke sath ba-kasrat is ka zikr kar, uski taraf mail aur sarasar raghib ho ja, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Fa iza faraghta fansab - 94. (Al-Sharh: 7), yaani jab apne shughl se farigh ho to hamari ibadat mehnat se baja lao, ikhlas, farigh-bali, koshish, mehnat, dil-lagi aur yaksui se Allah ki taraf jhuk jao, ek hadis mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne tabbut se mana kiya yaani baal-bachche aur duniya ko chhod dene se. Yahan matlab yeh hai ke alaiq-e-duniyawi se kat kar Allah ki ibadat mein tawajjo aur inhimak ka waqt bhi zaroor nikala karo. Woh Malik hai, woh mutasarif hai, mashriq maghrib sab uske qabze mein hain, uske siva ibadat ke layiq koi nahi, to jis tarah sirf usi Allah ki ibadat karta hai isi tarah sirf usi par bharosa bhi rakh, jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alayhi - 11. (Hud: 123) usi ki ibadat kar aur usi par bharosa kar, yahi mazmun aayat (Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in) mein bhi hai, is mani ki aur bhi bahut si aayten hain ke ibadat, ita'at, tawakkal aur bharosa ke layiq ek uski paak zat hai.))))

Rasoolullah ﷺ ko Qiyam-ul-Lail aur Tarteel-e-Quran ka hukm Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ﷺ ko hukm deta hai ke raton ke waqt kapre lapet kar so rehne ko chorein aur tahajjud ki namaz ke qiyam ko ikhtiyar kar lein, jaise farman hai ayat (TATAFAJU JUNUBUHUM 'ANIL MADAJI'I YAD'OUNA RABBAHUM KHAUFAW WA TAMA'AW WA MIMMA RAZAQNAHUM YUNFIQOUN 16) 32. (As-Sajdah: 16), un ke pehlu bastaron se alag hote hain aur apne Rabb ko khauf aur lalach se pukarte hain aur hamare diye hue mein se dete rehte hain, Huzoor ﷺ poori umar is hukm ki baja-awari karte rahe tahajjud ki namaz sirf aap par wajib thi yani ummat par wajib nahi hai, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (WA MINAL LAILI FATAHAJJAD BIHI NAFILATAN LAKA 'ASAA AN YAB'ATAKA RABBUKA MAQAMAN MAHMUDA 79) 17. (Al-Isra: 79), raton ko tahajjud parha kar yeh hukm sirf tujhe hai tera Rabb tujhe Maqam-e-Mahmoud mein pohchanewala hai, yahan is hukm ke sath hi miqdar bhi bayan farma di ke aadhe raat ya kuch kam o besh Muzammil ke ma'ani sone wale aur kapra lapetne wale ke hain, us waqt Huzoor ﷺ apni chadar orhe lete hue thay aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke aye Quran ke mafhoom ko achhi tarah akhz karne wale tu aadhi raat tak tahajjud mein mashghool raha kar, ya kuch barha ghata diya kar aur Quran Sharif ko aahista aahista thehar thehar kar parha kar taake khoob samajhta jaye, is hukm ke bhi Huzoor ﷺ amil thay, Hazrat Siddiqa R.A ka bayan hai ke aap Quran Kareem ko tarteel ke sath parhte thay jis se bari dair mein soorat khatam hoti thi goya choti si soorat bari se bari hojati thi, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Anas R.A se Rasulullah ﷺ ki qira'at ka wasf poocha jata hai toh aap farmate hain Huzoor ﷺ khoob madd kar ke parha karte thay phir ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) parh kar sunai jis mein lafz Allah par, lafz Rahman par, lafz Rahim par madd kiya, Ibn Jareej mein hai ke har har ayat par aap poora poora waqf karte thay, jaise ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) parh kar waqf karte, ayat (Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'Alamin) parh kar waqf karte, ayat (Ar-Rahmanir Rahim) parh kar waqf karte, ayat (Maliki Yawmiddin) parh kar theharte. Yeh hadith Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai.

Musnad Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Quran ke qari se qayamat wale din kaha jayega ke parhta ja aur charhta ja aur tartees se parh jaise duniya mein tarteel se parha karta tha tera darja woh hai jahan teri aakhri ayat khatam ho, yeh hadith Abu Dawood o Tirmizi aur Nasai mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmizi Rahimahullah ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, hum ne is tafsir ke shuru mein woh ahadith warid kar di hain, jo tarteel ke mustahab hone aur achhi aawaz se Quran parhne par dalalat karti hain, jaise woh hadith jis mein hai Quran ko apni aawazon se muzayyan karo, aur hum mein se woh hain jo khush-awazi se Quran na parhe aur Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ki nisbat Huzoor ﷺ ka yeh farmana ke ise Aal-e-Dawood ki khush-awazi ata ki gayi hai aur Hazrat Abu Musa ka farmana ke agar mujhe maloom hota ke aap sun rahe hain toh main aur achhe gale se zyada umdagi ke sath parhta, Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ka farman ke rait ki tarah Quran ko na phailao aur sheron ki tarah Quran ko be-adabi se na parho is ki ajaib par ghor karo aur dilon mein asar lete jao aur is mein daur na lagao ke jald surat khatam ho (Baghawi) ek shakhs aa kar Hazrat Ibn Masood se kehta hai maine mufassal ki tamam suratein aaj ki raat ek hi rakat mein parh daaliin aap ne farmaya phir toh tu ne sheron ki tarah jaldi jaldi parha hoga mujhe barabar barabar ki suratein khoob yaad hain jinhe Rasool Kareem ﷺ mila kar parha karte thay phir mufassal ki suraton mein se bees suraton ke naam liye ke un mein se do do suratein Huzoor ﷺ ek ek rakat mein parha karte thay. Phir farmata hai hum tujh par anqareeb bhaari bojh-hal baat utarenge, yani amal mein saqeel hogi aur utarte waqt ba-wajh apni azmat ke giraan-qadar hogi, Hazrat Zaid bin Sabit R.A farmate hain ke ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ par wahi utri us waqt aap ka ghutna mere ghutne par tha wahi ka itna bojh para ke main toh darne laga ke meri raan kahin toot na jaye, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A farmate hain maine Rasool Allah ﷺ se pucha ke wahi ka ehsas bhi aap ko hota hai? Aap ne farmaya main aisi aawaz sunta hoon jaise kisi zanjeer ke bajne ki aawaz ho main chupka hojata hoon jab bhi wahi nazil hoti hai mujh par itna bojh parta hai ke main samajhta hoon ke meri jaan nikal jayegi, Sahih Bukhari Sharif ke shuru mein hai Hazrat Haris bin Hisham puchte hain Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap ke paas wahi kis tarah aati hai?

Aap ne farmaya kabhi to ghanti ki aawaz ki tarah hoti hai jo mujh par bahut bhaari parti hai aur woh gun-gunaahat ki aawaz khatam hojati hai toh main us mein jo kuch kaha gaya woh mujhe khoob mehfooz hojata hai aur kabhi farishta insani soorat mein mere paas aata hai aur mujh se kalaam karta hai aur main yaad kar leta hoon, Hazrat Aisha (R.A) farmati hain main ne dekha hai ki sakht jaare wale din mein bhi jab aap par wahi utar chakti toh aap ki peshani mubarak se paseene ke qatre tapakte, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ki kabhi oontni par Huzoor (ﷺ) sawaar hote aur usi taaqat mein wahi aati toh oontni jhuk jati, Ibn Jareer mein yeh bhi hai ki phir jab tak wahi khatam na ho le oontni se qadam na uthaya jata na us ki gardan oonchi hoti. Matlab yeh hai ki khud wahi ka utrna bhi ahem aur bojhhal tha phir ahkaam ka baja lana aur un ka aamil hona bhi ahem aur bojhhal tha. Yahi qool Hazrat Imam Ibn Jareer ka hai, Hazrat Abdur Rahman se manqool hai ki jis tarah duniya mein yeh saqeel kaam hai usi tarah aakhirat mein ajr bhi bada bhaari milega. Phir farmata hai raat ka uthna nafs ko zer karne ke liye aur zubaan ko durust karne ke liye ikseer hai, nishaa ke maani habshi zubaan mein qiyaam karne ke hain, raat bhar mein jab uthe use ناشئتہ اللیل (Nashitat-ul-Lail) kehte hain, Tahajjud ki namaz ki khoobi yeh hai ki dil aur zubaan ek hojata hai aur tilaawat ke jo alfaaz zubaan se nikalte hain dil mein gad jaate hain aur nisbat din ke raat ki tanhai mein maani khoob zehen-nasheen hota jata hai kyunki din bheed-bhaad ka, shor-ghul ka, kamai-dhande ka waqt hota hai. Hazrat Anas ne ayat (Aqwaama qeela) ko Aswaba qeela padha toh logon ne kaha hum toh aqwaam padhte hain. Aap ne farmaya (Aswab aqwam ahyaa) aur un jaise sab alfaaz ham-maani hain. Phir farmata hai din mein tujhe bahut faraghat hai, neend kar sakte ho, so baith sakte ho, rahat haasil kar sakte ho, nawafil bakasrat ada kar sakte ho, is se duniyavi kaam-kaaj poore kar sakte ho. Phir raat ko aakhirat ke kaam ke liye khaas kar lo, is bina par yeh hukm us waqt tha jab raat ki namaz farz thi phir Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apne bandon par ehsaan kiya aur ba-toor takhfeef ke is mein kami kar di aur farmaya thodi si raat ka qiyaam karo, is farmaan ke baad Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam ne ayat (Inna Rabbaka) se (Faqra'u ma tayassara minhu) (Al-Muzzammil: 20) tak padha aur ayat (Wa minallaili fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka 'asa an yab'athaka Rabbuka Maqaman Mahmooda) (Al-Isra: 79), ki bhi tilaawat ki.

Uske baad ki ayat ke do maane hain ek toh yeh ki agar tum ne kufr kiya toh batao toh sahi ki us din ke azabon se kaise najat hasil karoge? Jis din ki haibat khauf aur darr bachon ko burha kar dega aur doosre maane yeh ki agar tum ne itne bare haul-naak din ka bhi kufr kiya aur uske bhi munkar rahe toh tumhe taqwa aur Allah ka darr kaise hasil hoga? Go yeh dono maane yeh ki agar tum ne itne bare haul-naak din ka bhi kufr kiya aur uske bhi munkar rahe toh tumhe taqwa aur Allah ka darr kaise hasil hoga? Go yeh dono maane nihayat umda hain lekin awwal aula hain Wallahu A'lam. Paigam-e-Naseerat-o-Ibrat aur Qiyam-e-Lail

Farmata hai ke yeh surat aql-mandoon ke liye sarasar naseerat-o-ibrat hai jo bhi talib-e-hidayat ho woh marzi-e-Maula se hidayat ka rasta pa lega aur apne Rab ki taraf pahunch jaane ka zariya hasil kar lega, jaise dusri surat mein farmaya Ayat: (Wa ma tasha'una illa an yasha'allahu innal-laha kana 'aliman hakima) (Al-Insan: 30) Tumhari chahat kaam nahi aati wahi hota hai jo Allah chahe. Sahih ilm wala aur puri hikmat wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir farmata hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi ﷺ) aap ka aur aap ke ashab ki ek jama'at ka kabhi do tahai raat tak qiyam mein mashghul rehna kabhi aadhi raat usi mein guzarna kabhi tahai raat tak tahajjud parhna Allah Ta'ala ko bakhubi malum hai go tumhara maqsad thik us waqt ko pura karna nahi hota aur hai bhi woh mushkil kaam, kyunke raat din ka sahi andaza Allah hi ko hai kabhi dono barabar hote hain kabhi raat choti din bara, kabhi din chhota raat bari, Allah janta hai ke is ko banne ki taqat tum mein nahi toh ab raat ki namaz itni hi parho jitni tum ba-asani parh sako koi waqt muqarrar nahi ke farzan itna waqt toh lagana hi hoga yahan salat ki tabir qira'at se ki hai jaise Surah Subhan mein ki hai Ayat: (Wa la tajhar bi-salatika wa la tukhafit biha wa abtaghi baina zalika sabila) (17. Bani (Israel: 110)

(Al-Isra: 110) Na toh bohot buland kar na bilkul past kar. Imam Abu Hanifah Rahimahullah ke ashab ne is ayat se istadlal kar ke yeh masla liya hai ke namaz mein Surah Fatihah hi ka padhna mutayyin nahi, ise padhe khwah aur kahin se padh le go ek hi ayat padhe kafi hai aur phir is masle ki mazbooti is hadis se ki hai jis mein hai ke bohot jaldi jaldi namaz ada karne wale ko Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha "phir padh jo asan ho tere sath Quran se" (Bukhari o Muslim). Yeh mazhab jumhoor ke khilaf hai aur jumhoor ne inhein yeh jawab diya hai ke Bukhari o Muslim ki Hadrat Ubadah bin Samit wali hadis mein aa chuka hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya ke "namaz nahi hai magar yeh ke tu Surah Fatihah padhe" aur Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bi riwayat Hadrat Abu Hurairah R.A marwi hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya "har woh namaz jis mein Surah Fatihah na padi jaye woh bilkul adhuri, mahz nakara, naqis aur natamam hai". Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah mein bhi un hi ki riwayat se hai, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke "us shakhs ki namaz nahi hoti jo Surah Fatihah na padhe" (pas theek qaul jumhoor ka hi hai ke har namaz ki har ek rakat mein Surah Fatihah ka padhna lazmi aur mutayyin hai). 

Phir farmata hai ke Allah ko maloom hai ke is ummat mein uzr wale log bhi hain jo qiyam-ul-lail ke tark par mazoor hain, misal ke taur par bimar ke jinhein is ki taqat nahi, musafir jo rozi ki talash mein idhar udhar ja rahe hain, mujahid jo aham-tar shughal mein mashghool hain. Yeh ayat balki yeh poori surat Makki hai, Makkah Sharif mein nazil hui, us waqt jihad farz nahi tha balki musalman nihayat past halat mein the, phir ghaib ki yeh khabar dena aur usi tarah zuhoor mein bhi ana ke musalman jihad mein poori tarah mashghool hue, yeh nabuwat ki aala aur behtareen daleel hai. Toh in mazoorat ke baais tumhein rukhsat di jati hai ke jitna qiyam tum se ba-asani kiya ja sake kar liya karo. 

Hadrat Abu Raja Muhammad ne Hasan Rahimahullah se pucha ke Aey Abu Saeed! Us shakhs ke bare mein aap kya farmate hain jo poore Quran ka hafiz hai lekin tahajjud nahi padhta sirf farz namaz padhta hai? Aap ne farmaya: Us ne Quran ko takiya bana liya, us par Allah ki lanat ho. Allah Ta'ala ne apne naik ghulam ke liye farmaya ke woh hamare ilm ko janne wala hai aur farmaya tum woh sikhaye gaye ho jise na tum jante the na tumhare baap dada. Maine kaha.

Abu Saeed Allah Ta'ala toh farmata hai jo Quran asani se tum parh sako parho, farmaya haan theek toh hai paanch aayetein hi parh lo, pas ba-zahir maloom hota hai ke hafiz-e-Quran ka raat ki namaz mein kuch na kuch qiyam karna Imam Hasan Basri ke nazeeq haq o wajib tha, ek hadith bhi is par dalalat karti hai jis mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se us shakhs ke bare mein sawal hua jo subh tak soya rehta hai farmaya yeh woh shakhs hai jis ke kaan mein Shaitan peshab karjata hai us ka toh ek toh yeh matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke is se murad woh shakhs hai jo Isha ke farz bhi na parhe aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jo raat ko nafli qiyam na kare, sunan ki hadith mein hai aye Quran walon Witr parha karo, doosri riwayat mein hai jo Witr nahi parhe woh hum mein se nahi, Hasan Basri ke qaul se bhi zyada ghareeb qaul Abu Bakr bin Abdul Aziz Hambali ka hai jo kehte hain ke Ramazan ke mahine ka qiyam farz hai Wallahu A'lam (yeh yaad rahe ke sahi maslak yahi hai ke Tahajjud ki namaz na toh Ramazan mein wajib hai na ghair Ramazan mein. Ramazan ki baabat bhi Hadith-e-Sharif mein saaf aa chuka hai wa qiyamu lailatin tatawwuan ya'ani Allah ne is ke qiyam ko nafli qarar diya hai waghera Wallahu A'lam. (Mutarjim) Tabrani ki hadith mein is ayat ki tafseer mein buhat marfoo'an marwi hai ke go sau hi aayetein hon, lekin yeh hadith buhat ghareeb hai sirf Mu'jam Tabrani mein hi main ne ise dekha hai. Phir irshad hai ke farz namazon ki hifazat karo aur farz zakat ki adayegi kiya karo, yeh ayat un hazraat ki daleel hai jo farmate hain farziyat-e-zakat ka hukm Makkah Sharif mein hi nazil ho chuka tha haan kitni nikali jaye? Farmata hai ke yeh surat aql-mandoon ke liye sarasar naseerat-o-ibrat hai jo bhi talib-e-hidayat ho woh marzi-e-Maula se hidayat ka rasta pa lega aur apne Rab ki taraf pahunch jaane ka zariya hasil kar lega, jaise dusri surat mein farmaya Ayat: (Wa ma tasha'una illa an yasha'allahu innal-laha kana 'aliman hakima) (Al-Insan: 30) Tumhari chahat kaam nahi aati wahi hota hai jo Allah chahe. Sahih ilm wala aur puri hikmat wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir farmata hai ke اے نبی ﷺ (Aiy Nabi ﷺ) aap ka aur aap ke ashab ki ek jama'at ka kabhi do tahai raat tak qiyam mein mashghul rehna kabhi aadhi raat usi mein guzarna kabhi tahai raat tak tahajjud parhna Allah Ta'ala ko bakhubi malum hai go tumhara maqsad thik us waqt ko pura karna nahi hota aur hai bhi woh mushkil kaam, kyunke raat din ka sahi andaza Allah hi ko hai kabhi dono barabar hote hain kabhi raat choti din bara, kabhi din chhota raat bari, Allah janta hai ke is ko banne ki taqat tum mein nahi toh ab raat ki namaz itni hi parho jitni tum ba-asani parh sako koi waqt muqarrar nahi ke farzan itna waqt toh lagana hi hoga yahan salat ki tabir qira'at se ki hai jaise Surah Subhan mein ki hai Ayat: (Wa la tajhar bi-salatika wa la tukhafit biha wa abtaghi baina zalika sabila) (17. Bani (Israel: 110)

(Al-Isra: 110) Na toh bohot buland kar na bilkul past kar. Imam Abu Hanifah Rahimahullah ke ashab ne is ayat se istadlal kar ke yeh masla liya hai ke namaz mein Surah Fatihah hi ka padhna mutayyin nahi, ise padhe khwah aur kahin se padh le go ek hi ayat padhe kafi hai aur phir is masle ki mazbooti is hadis se ki hai jis mein hai ke bohot jaldi jaldi namaz ada karne wale ko Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha "phir padh jo asan ho tere sath Quran se" (Bukhari o Muslim). Yeh mazhab jumhoor ke khilaf hai aur jumhoor ne inhein yeh jawab diya hai ke Bukhari o Muslim ki Hadrat Ubadah bin Samit wali hadis mein aa chuka hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya ke "namaz nahi hai magar yeh ke tu Surah Fatihah padhe" aur Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bi riwayat Hadrat Abu Hurairah R.A marwi hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya "har woh namaz jis mein Surah Fatihah na padi jaye woh bilkul adhuri, mahz nakara, naqis aur natamam hai". Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah mein bhi un hi ki riwayat se hai, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya ke "us shakhs ki namaz nahi hoti jo Surah Fatihah na padhe" (pas theek qaul jumhoor ka hi hai ke har namaz ki har ek rakat mein Surah Fatihah ka padhna lazmi aur mutayyin hai). 

Phir farmata hai ke Allah ko maloom hai ke is ummat mein uzr wale log bhi hain jo qiyam-ul-lail ke tark par mazoor hain, misal ke taur par bimar ke jinhein is ki taqat nahi, musafir jo rozi ki talash mein idhar udhar ja rahe hain, mujahid jo aham-tar shughal mein mashghool hain. Yeh ayat balki yeh poori surat Makki hai, Makkah Sharif mein nazil hui, us waqt jihad farz nahi tha balki musalman nihayat past halat mein the, phir ghaib ki yeh khabar dena aur usi tarah zuhoor mein bhi ana ke musalman jihad mein poori tarah mashghool hue, yeh nabuwat ki aala aur behtareen daleel hai. Toh in mazoorat ke baais tumhein rukhsat di jati hai ke jitna qiyam tum se ba-asani kiya ja sake kar liya karo.
